tables.name: Special Feature
tables.description: What makes the fortress worthy of notice; each then rolls its specifics.

results.name: Resident - Great Person
results.description: A person of significance, or renown, lives here.

results.name: Resident - Creature or Monster
results.description: A beast, monster, or uncivilised entity resides here. Depending on the other residents of the fortress, it may have chosen to make its home here, or is a captive.

results.name: Magical Properties
results.description: The structure and/or its surroundings have magical properties.

results.name: Unknown Origin
results.description: No one knows where this structure came from, or how it was built.

results.name: Intriguing Purpose
results.description: The structure was built to do something unusual.

results.name: Catastrophic Event
results.description: The structure was the site of a terrible or tragic incident.

results.name: Miraculous Event
results.description: The structure was the site of something miraculous or amazing.

results.name: Bizarre Location
results.description: The structure is built in an atypical kind of location.
